name: Essence Flight School
category: Program prices, ranges and partial rates
summary: Van Nuys school that sells private pilot training as packages sized by hours.
differentiator: Sells private pilot training as three packages by hours (40, 60 or 80 total) starting at $10,900, so you pick the hours assumption instead of guessing it.
pricing: Private pilot from $10,900; discovery flights $229 to $499; no hourly rates on the page.

estimate.hoursBasis: its Standard package, 40 total flight hours; the Comprehensive package is 60 hours and the Premium package 80
